source:
Our protagonist has three big-breasted sisters.
However, his sisters are so in love with their little brother that their worried parents have issued a restraining order against them.
But when his parents suddenly go on a business trip overseas, his sisters seize the opportunity to make advances on him.
They secretly mix a powerful aphrodisiac into his food, exposing their huge breasts to his rising desires.
While their parents are away, the younger brother couldn't resist the temptations of his older sisters any longer and they ended up having sex!
And perhaps due to the effects of the aphrodisiac, his desire continued to rise no matter how many times he ejaculated.
Then he spend every day having sex with his sisters.
If this keeps up, will his older sisters really get pregnant?!
